status_detail: No engine publishes plans yet. Four engines run as a labelled paper test below; an engine joins this record only after it passes its promotion criteria on forward data.

strategies.name: Compression Release
strategies.public_summary: A stock breaks out of a tight base, then retests the breakout level and holds it. Paper test: every setup is recorded before the open and graded forward. Not a recommendation.

strategies.name: Failed Breakdown Reclaim
strategies.public_summary: A stock breaks below an established range, the break fails, and it closes back inside the range on volume. The stop sits below the failed-breakdown low. Paper test: recorded before the open and graded forward. Not a recommendation.

strategies.name: Opening Demand Continuation
strategies.public_summary: Unusually strong opening participation that carries through the morning. Intraday: graded after each session by replaying its 5-minute bars in order. Paper only: the decision happens at 09:35-11:00, so an evening message can never be acted on.

strategies.name: Technical Confluence
strategies.public_summary: A five-part chart read: trend phase from the 50 and 200 EMA, support and resistance zones, RSI with divergence, volume confirmation and extension, scored out of ten. A paper setup needs 7 or more in an uptrend, defined risk to support and 2R of room. The score counts conditions met; it is not a probability.

costs.includes: STT, exchange, SEBI and stamp charges, GST and DP charges on an assumed delivery schedule with zero brokerage; not a broker's contract note

fills_are: simulated from daily bars under conservative rules; no order is placed
notice: Conditional paper plans for the NEXT session. No engine has yet passed its promotion criteria. Not investment advice. No probability, forecast or guaranteed outcome is implied.

metrics.population: Signal forward record: NSE equities, long only, every strategy cleared to publish

history.basis: One row per NSE session since the forward record began. NAV is the paper book marked at that session's close, recorded the same evening and never revised; a session that was not scanned has no NAV. The benchmark is a price index, not a total-return index.

paper.basis: Paper test. Each setup is recorded after the close, before the session it is for, and graded forward under the same rules with simulated fills. No order is placed. These are not the published plans and are not counted in the record above. No average is shown before 30 closed trades.

engines.name: Technical Confluence
engines.what: Five-part chart read scored out of 10; a paper setup needs 7+ in an uptrend, a defined stop under support and 2R of room to resistance.

engines.name: Failed Breakdown Reclaim
engines.what: A range breaks down, the break fails, and price closes back inside on volume.

engines.name: Compression Release
engines.what: A breakout from a tight base that retests the level and holds it.

engines.name: Opening Demand Continuation
engines.what: Heavy opening volume that carries above the opening range by 11:00. Graded after the close on 5-minute bars; it can never be acted on from an evening message.
